Desc: The Sticky Bomb Launcher Burn variant shoots an adhesive payload that burns the target and creates a flame that can ignite nearby hostiles. It can be remote detonated to burn a large area.
The Sticky Bomb Launcher EMP variant shoots an adhesive payload that disrupts the target continuously. It can be remote detonated to create a large EMP blast.
The Sticky Bomb Launcher Explosive variant shoots an adhesive payload that causes panic in targets, and can be remote detonated for a large explosion.

The Repair Trap scatters a minefield of small devices capable of repairing friendlies in their proximity.

Cooldown reduced when traps expire.

The Shock Trap scatters a minefield of small devices capable of shocking targets moving in their proximity.

Cooldown reduced when traps expire.
The Shrapnel Tap scatters a minefield of small explosive devices that can attach to any surface (including enemies) and then detonate based on enemy proximity.
The Distraction Decoy creates a lifelike projection of a threat to hostiles, drawing their attention from the user.

Target a single enemy with a pulse which identifies weaknesses, highlights them and causes damage to those areas to take headshot damage.

Useful for solo snipers, or as a support skill user painting targets for your teammates.
The banshee launches a forward arc of pulse energy that disorients enemies caught in the wave. Penetrates cover.
The jammer pulses outwards, overloading and disabling hostile electronics.
The remote is deployed at a set location and continually pulses the nearby area for hostiles and visually highlights them on the agent's HUD.
The scanner pulses the surrounding area for hostiles and visually highlights them on the agent's HUD.
The artillery turret launches ordnance at nearby targeted locations.
The assault turret automatically tracks and attacks hostile targets, but this behavior can be manually overridden to target a specific enemy.
The incinerator turret is manually controlled by the deploying agent to dispense streams of flame in a forward-facing cone.
The sniper turret fires high-caliber rounds at manually selected targets.

The Artificer sends out micro electro-booster drones that expend themselves to increase allied skills efficiency and refresh their duration.  Periodically releases a drone whilst holstered, this drone affects only your skills.
The booster hive delivers a stimulant to nearby allies that increases their weapon handling, hazard protection, and melee damage.
The restorer hive sends out micro repair drones that expend themselves to repair allies' armor.
The reviver hive deploys small drones that revive nearby downed allies.
The stinger hive sends out micro drones that attack and distract nearby enemy targets.
The firestarter cannister creates a cloud of explosive gas that can be ignited through explosives, weapon fire, etc.
The oxidizer cannister releases a cloud of corrosive gas that damages enemy armor, skill proxies and causes damage over time.
The reinforcer cannister disperses a cloud of gas that repairs and reinforces armor of anyone inside the cloud.
The riot foam cannister fires a payload of sticky foam that immobilizes targets.
The blinder firefly blinds enemies that it passes over, causing them to be unable to function at full combat effectiveness.
The burster firefly attaches explosive charges to targets that detonate if two are in close proximity.
The demolisher firefly damages or destroys enemy weak points, skill proxies and environmental explosives.
The airburst seeker mine rolls toward its target, and launches an explosive burst into the air on reaching close proximity.
The cluster seeker mine splits into smaller seekers and track down enemies, exploding when reaching proximity. No more than one seeker may target an individual enemy.
The explosive seeker mine can be deployed to track down hostiles and explode on reaching close proximity.
The mender seeker mine follows allies, repairing their armor.
The bombardier requires that an agent set two points, and then deploy a payload of miniature explosives between them.
The defender attempts to deflect incoming bullets from a microwave emitter mounted beneath the drone.
The fixer replenishes nearby allies' armor, or can be manually targeted on a specfic ally.
The striker tracks targets and attempts to maintain line of sight while continuously firing.
The tactician scouts and marks hostile targets, feeding them to the agent and other allies' HUD.

The bulwark shield provides near full-body coverage, but its bulk means that only sidearms may be used while it's equipped.

Shield Skill Tier increases with both [Armor] and [Skill] core attributes.

Agents are briefly disoriented when shield breaks from hostile damage.

The crusader shield allows primary weapons (excluding light machine guns and marksman rifles) to be used while it's equipped, but exposes the agent's legs.

Shield Skill Tier increases with both [Armor] and [Skill] core attributes.

Agents are briefly disoriented when shield breaks from hostile damage.

The deflector shield causes incoming bullets to ricochet at nearby highlighted targets with clear line of sight to the agent. Though not a full-body shield, lack of a brace means that only a sidearm may be used alongside the shield.

Shield Skill Tier increases with both [Armor] and [Skill] core attributes.

Agents are briefly disoriented when shield breaks from hostile damage.

The striker shield is a modified version of the crusader shield, allowing the K8-JetStream Flamethrower signature weapon to be used while equipped.

In addition, the striker shield boosts the damage of the user and all allies behind them based on the number of enemies in front of the shield.

Shield Skill Tier increases with both [Armor] and [Skill] core attributes.

Agents are briefly disoriented when shield breaks from hostile damage.

The Precision Smart Cover Launcher fires a projectile that drills into any surface, reinforcing nearby covers and granting enhanced weapon handling, damage and automatic reload on swapping to all agents using it.

The Fortified Smart Cover Launcher fires a projectile that drills into any surface, reinforcing nearby covers and granting extra armor, resistances and immunity to stagger effects to all agents using it.
